name: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd.
summary: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of smart home appliances. It operates through five segments: Home Cooking Solutions; Air Energy Solutions; Household Laundry and Care of Washing Machines and Dyers; Whole-Home Water Solutions; and Other Businesses. The company provides refrigerators/freezers, air conditioners, water heaters, laundry equipment, kitchen and small appliances, and smart home solutions.
